name: Topic-Classification
description: Dataset for multiclass topic classification of news articles into World, Sports, Business, or Sci/Tech categories. Each sample consists of a news article snippet and an instruction to classify it, with the target category provided.
card_text: This dataset contains 200 text samples for topic classification of news articles. Each sample includes a news article snippet (title and description) as the input context, and a prompt instructing the model to classify the article into one of four categories: World, Sports, Business, or Sci/Tech. The output is a single category label. The data is in English, sourced from news headlines and short descriptions. The task evaluates a model's ability to categorize short news texts into predefined topics based on their content. Assumptions: the dataset is balanced or at least representative of the four classes, and the classification is single-label.

context.semantics: The raw_text field contains a news article snippet, typically consisting of a title and a brief description. It serves as the main input to be classified into a topic category.

question.semantics: The prompt field provides explicit instructions to classify the news article into one of four categories: World, Sports, Business, or Sci/Tech. It asks for only the category name as output.

answer.semantics: The topic field contains the ground-truth category label for the news article, such as 'Business' or 'Sci/Tech'. It is the target output the model should produce.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample contains a news article snippet (raw_text) as context and a classification instruction prompt (prompt) as question. The target output is a single topic category (topic) from a predefined set of four classes. The context and question are combined in the input, and the answer is stored separately in the output.
